verdict.rationale: A library of ready-made project templates is a fair question for a scraping API platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents a Postman collection, a dashboard Request Builder, a CLI and dedicated per-site APIs, but no starter project or template library. These are adjacent developer aids, not templates, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building immediately using a library of ready-made project templates
